for primary works in
the light of
recommendation of
Finance Commission
(Establishment and
Committed
Expenditure)
column7:
Reduction in provision
of ₹9,144.32 lakh was
the net effect of increase
of ₹7,680.00 lakhand
surrender of
₹16,824.32 lakh.
Increase was attributed
to need of additional
amounts inGrants-in-aid
Non-Salary and Grants-
in-aid-creation of assets.
Surrender was attributed
to non-release of
amounts of 15th finance
commission to
municipal bodiesformed
after 01-04-2020 by the
Government of India.
Final excess of ₹101.22
lakh is overstated by
₹104.79 lakh due to
clearance of OB
suspense related to
previous years.
Therefore, it is actual
saving of ₹3.57 lakh.
Reasons for actual
saving have not been
intimated (July 2024).
